label: Pecorino Sardo
note: Two types: dolce (20–60 d) and maturo (over 2 months). The only Sardinian PDO set with calf rennet.

about.text: Pecorino Sardo is a firm cheese from Sardinia made from the milk of the local Sarda sheep. It has PDO status and comes as dolce, aged 20 to 60 days, and maturo, aged more than 2 months.

steps.note: Dolce is pasteurised at 72 °C for 15 s, maturo thermised at 68 °C for at most 15 s.

microbes.name: lactic ferments of the production area

steps.note: Lactic ferments from the production area restore the flora killed by heating; the species are not named.

processing.text: Dolce ripens 20-60 d, maturo over 2 months.
